summary_md: **TopG ([@topg_openmaus](https://x.com/topg_openmaus/status/2115005810069684248))** summarizes **DeployBench**: can an agent rebuild and run a paper's code from a fresh VM? Across 51 artifacts five models scored 7.8–51%, and in 102 of 181 failures agents stopped after checking a weaker target.

referenced_urls.title: DeployBench: Benchmarking LLM Agents for Research Artifact Deployment

relevance: Highlights premature success claims in research-reproduction agents.
